document.title: Surface lookFor and sources as triage lanes
document.summary: `LookForIndex` is a compact owner index on Overview. Group pages still list the full claims. Sources jump to a citing claim, a line pin, or the named group. The header group pager and part hops from #75 stay.
document.why: [#71](source:s1) wants lookFor and sources as a scan-and-jump triage surface, not a forge comment host.

sources.title: Surface lookFor and sources as triage lanes
sources.gist: List claims with source marks and jump into the owning group. Do not store pass/fail.

sources.label: PR #76
sources.title: Surface lookFor and sources as triage lanes
sources.gist: Rebased onto main after #75. Compact Overview lookFor. Keep part chrome.

lookFor: [#71](source:s1) says do not store pass/fail. No hunk adds a checkbox or completion state on a claim.
Subtle. [#71](source:s1) wants a place to scan and jump. Overview shows owner counts, not the full claim dump.

groups.title: Claim model and jump targets
groups.why: The rest of the UI needs one owner-aware claim list and a source open target.
groups.summary: `lookFor.ts` parses tags, buckets claims by owner, and maps a source to a selection.
lookFor: Breaking. `lookForClaims` numbers owners with `groupOrderIndex`, so a dependsOn reorder must not keep document-array labels.

groups.title: Overview index and group lists
groups.why: [#71](source:s1) needs a scan surface on Overview and the full list next to the diff.
groups.summary: `LookForIndex` counts owners on Overview. `LookForList` still lists every claim on the group page.
lookFor: Open the Overview document row: whole-change claims stay behind a closed details until that row is opened.

groups.title: App wiring for jumps
groups.why: Clicks on claims and sources have to change selection without dropping the #75 pager.
groups.summary: `App.tsx` keeps `[` `]` and `{` `}` on `selectFromNav`, and opens lookFor plus sources through `openLookFor` and `openSource`.
lookFor: Press `]` from Overview: lookFor focus clears. Header chevrons use the same `selectFromNav` path.

commits.subject: Surface lookFor and sources as scan-and-jump lanes.
commits.author: Cursor Agent
commits.body:
Overview lists every document and group lookFor claim with its owner and source marks. Opening a claim goes to that group or stays on Overview. Sources jump to the first citing claim, line pin, or named group. Claims stay claims: no pass/fail state.

Co-authored-by: Máté Molnár <matemolnar8@users.noreply.github.com>
